reviews.title: Perfect Choice for Picky Eaters Like Cosmo
reviews.text:
I’m really happy with the Original Dog Food – Lamb & Rice 3kg. My boy Cosmo (English Cocker Spaniel) has always eaten Black Hawk biscuits since he was a puppy, so I wasn’t sure how he’d go with trying something new.
To my surprise, he took to it straight away, which is always a good sign, especially since he can be a bit fussy with new food.
The lamb and rice combination seems gentle on his stomach, and I’ve noticed improved digestion and consistent energy levels since starting him on it. His coat is looking healthier too, which tells me the quality of ingredients is solid.
The kibble size is perfect, and the 3 kg bag is convenient for storage and keeping the food fresh.
Overall, a reliable everyday option. Would definitely recommend to other dog owners looking for a balanced and well tolerated dry food.
